findings.title: Model Router Call Log Missing

evidence.observation: Model router is reachable and active, but call_log_exists is false for /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl.

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router service creates and writes to call_log.jsonl to maintain call traceability and performance auditing.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into runtime model invocations, latencies, and failure metrics.
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: observability_gap; Evidence strength: conclusive; Confidence: 0.95; Risk: medium; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Changes to running services require verification

findings.title: Direct LLM API Key Invocations in Emergency Alerts

evidence.observation: Direct calls to call_gemini and call_mistral using environment variables instead of routing through the model router.

proposed_action.description: Update emergency alert generation to query the centralized model router endpoint rather than bypassing via direct SDK client calls.

findings.expected_benefit: Enforces unified rate limiting, observability, failover routing, and cost accounting across all LLM requests.
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: router_bypass; Evidence strength: conclusive; Confidence: 0.90; Risk: medium; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Router bypasses must be corrected by design review
